What we hear from dealers

Each store prices off its own numbers, not today's market.

Appraisals

Two stores, two numbers on the same trade

Each store checks the market its own way: listing searches, competitor sites and experience. A sister store can quote a different ACV on the same unit.

Pricing

Starting too high, or leaving gross on the table

Customers fix on the highest asking price they found online. Too high and the unit sits. Too low and you give away gross.

Aging

Every extra day costs floorplan interest

Every unit past 180 days adds interest and curtailments. By month-end, the wholesaler is often the only way out.

Lost trades

Customers walk, and you never learn the number

The store down the road wins the trade, and you never find out what they offered or what it sold for.

Questions dealers ask

Before you book the call.

Anything else, ask the founders on the demo.

Book a demo
How do you know what a unit sold for?

Units that are listed one day and gone the next are counted as sold. We do not access private dealer transaction systems.

Does it help with ordering?

Yes. Before you order, see which floor plans are selling fastest within the miles you pick, what they sold for and how much supply is already out there.

Do I have to change my DMS or website?

No. Most dealerships are up, connected and pulling live market data within days. Rapidious Titan sits on top of how you already price, and it does not replace your DMS.

How long before my managers are using it?

Training videos and live training sessions are included, so your managers know the routine from the first week.

Is there a contract?

No contract, no setup fee, and 30 days free. Pricing depends on your number of stores, so book a demo for a quote.

Does it work for a single store?

Yes. It works the same for a single store or a multi-store dealer: the same market data, pricing and comp sheets.
